# rgmond metric reference

<!-- Generated by `rgmond docs metrics` from src/collect/spec*.toml. Do not edit. -->

Metadata rgmond sends for each metric. In names, `{}` stands for a device, interface, mount, port, process or unit name; in descriptions it is shown as X, and MOUNT is the mount point. Metrics of origin *gmond* reproduce gmond 3.7's metadata; metrics of origin *rgmond* are additions.

| Name | Group | Type | Units | Origin | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gexec` | core | string |  | gmond | gexec available |
| `heartbeat` | core | uint32 |  | gmond | Last heartbeat |
| `location` | core | string | (x,y,z) | gmond | Location of the machine |
| `cpu_aidle` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percent of time since boot idle CPU |
| `cpu_ctxt` | cpu | float | ctxs/sec | gmond | Context Switches |
| `cpu_idle` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percentage of time that the CPU or CPUs were idle and the system did not have an outstanding disk I/O request |
| `cpu_intr` | cpu | float | % | gmond | cpu_intr |
| `cpu_nice` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percentage of CPU utilization that occurred while executing at the user level with nice priority |
| `cpu_num` | cpu | uint16 | CPUs | gmond | Total number of CPUs |
| `cpu_sintr` | cpu | float | % | gmond | cpu_sintr |
| `cpu_speed` | cpu | uint32 | MHz | gmond | CPU Speed in terms of MHz |
| `cpu_steal` | cpu | float | % | gmond | cpu_steal |
| `cpu_system` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percentage of CPU utilization that occurred while executing at the system level |
| `cpu_user` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percentage of CPU utilization that occurred while executing at the user level |
| `cpu_wio` | cpu | float | % | gmond | Percentage of time that the CPU or CPUs were idle during which the system had an outstanding disk I/O request |
| `procs_blocked` | cpu | float | processes | gmond | Processes blocked |
| `procs_created` | cpu | float | proc/sec | gmond | Number of processes and threads created |
| `disk_free` | disk | double | GB | gmond | Total free disk space |
| `disk_free_absolute_{}` | disk | float | GB | gmond | Disk space available (GB) on MOUNT |
| `disk_free_percent_{}` | disk | float | % | gmond | Disk space available (%) on MOUNT |
| `disk_total` | disk | double | GB | gmond | Total available disk space |
| `part_max_used` | disk | float | % | gmond | Maximum percent used for all partitions |
| `biolat_{}_avg_ms` | disk_latency | float | ms | rgmond | Mean block request latency on X, issue to completion, over the last interval (BPF) |
| `biolat_{}_p99_ms` | disk_latency | float | ms | rgmond | 99th percentile block request latency on X over the last interval, log2-bucket upper bound (BPF) |
| `diskstat_{}_io_time` | diskstat | float | s | gmond | The time in seconds spent in I/O operations |
| `diskstat_{}_percent_io_time` | diskstat | float | percent | gmond | The percent of disk time spent on I/O operations |
| `diskstat_{}_read_bytes_per_sec` | diskstat | float | bytes/sec | gmond | The number of bytes read per second |
| `diskstat_{}_read_time` | diskstat | float | s | gmond | The time in seconds spent reading |
| `diskstat_{}_reads` | diskstat | float | reads | gmond | The number of reads completed |
| `diskstat_{}_reads_merged` | diskstat | float | reads | gmond | The number of reads merged. Reads which are adjacent to each other may be merged for efficiency. Multiple reads may become one before it is handed to the disk, and it will be counted (and queued) as only one I/O. |
| `diskstat_{}_weighted_io_time` | diskstat | float | s | gmond | The weighted time in seconds spend in I/O operations. This measures each I/O start, I/O completion, I/O merge, or read of these stats by the number of I/O operations in progress times the number of seconds spent doing I/O. |
| `diskstat_{}_write_bytes_per_sec` | diskstat | float | bytes/sec | gmond | The number of bytes written per second |
| `diskstat_{}_write_time` | diskstat | float | s | gmond | The time in seconds spent writing |
| `diskstat_{}_writes` | diskstat | float | writes | gmond | The number of writes completed |
| `diskstat_{}_writes_merged` | diskstat | float | writes | gmond | The number of writes merged. Writes which are adjacent to each other may be merged for efficiency. Multiple writes may become one before it is handed to the disk, and it will be counted (and queued) as only one I/O. |
| `load_fifteen` | load | float |  | gmond | Fifteen minute load average |

| `load_one` | load | float |  | gmond | One minute load average |

| `mem_buffers` | memory | float | KB | gmond | Amount of buffered memory |
| `mem_cached` | memory | float | KB | gmond | Amount of cached memory |
| `mem_dirty` | memory | float | Bytes | gmond | The total amount of memory waiting to be written back to the disk.  |
| `mem_free` | memory | float | KB | gmond | Amount of available memory |
| `mem_hardware_corrupted` | memory | float | Bytes | gmond | HardwareCorrupted |
